question.text: Consider the equation $y-y_1=m\left(x-x_1\right)$. If $m$ and $x_1$ are fixed and different lines are drawn for different values of $y_1$, then

options.text: the lines will pass through a fixed point
there will be a set of parallel lines
all lines will be parallel to the line $y=x_1$

solution.text:
$m$ and $x_1$ are fixed and $y_1$ is variable
Hence, (B) There will be a set of parallel lines (C) All lines intersect the line $x=x_1$
